_doc: The DISPOSITION of every literal-default property of a QML template that no kcfg key reaches (W268; operator rule: every render-time value is exposed and effectful in the configuration view, for every widget and wallpaper). Kinds: STATE (a runtime value or a datum the mount feeds; no setting by nature), MOUNT (a size or geometry the mounting surface decides), WITHHELD:<reason> (a stated reason it is not a setting), OPEN:<waypoint> (a render value that SHOULD be a setting and is not yet: counted and printed as debt, never a pass). A property a kcfg key reaches needs no entry. scripts/check_render_constants.py reads this file; policy/render_constants.rego decides.
